signIn.title: Add a Command Code key
signIn.body: Create an API key at commandcode.ai/settings/keys and paste it here. A Provider-or-higher key is added to Command Code Plan, a Go plan key to Command Code Go Plan.
signIn.key.label: API key
signIn.key.hint: Kept encrypted by Astra; never shown again.
signIn.key.refused: Command Code didn't take this key
